temperature_offset.title: Temperature Offset (°C)
temperature_offset.description: Compensates for sensor self-heating. Written to the SCD30 hardware register. Typical values: 0–5°C.

i2c_bus.title: I2C Bus Number
i2c_bus.description: The I2C bus the SCD30 is connected to. Usually 1 on Raspberry Pi.

poll_interval.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
poll_interval.description: How often to read a measurement from the sensor.

co2_threshold.title: CO₂ Threshold (ppm)
co2_threshold.description: CO₂ level in ppm at which the CO₂ Detected characteristic switches to abnormal.
